Summary of websites posted to 'general' channel:

1. www.informations.com: Contains information about the latest job report showing unemployment edged down to 7.2%, bringing a mix of relief and concern.

2. www.restaurant-zurich.com: Describes Zurich Restaurant, a cozy alpine-inspired eatery in the city center renowned for authentic Swiss cuisine. Features include cheese fondue, rösti, chocolate fondue, warm wooden interiors with Swiss memorabilia, panoramic city views, and staff in traditional Swiss attire.

These are the only websites explicitly shared in the general channel messages.

Hi Dora! I visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com). It's a clean, minimal site with your email displayed. Great start! Consider adding an about section, a portfolio or projects, and maybe a blog to share updates. Looking forward to seeing it grow!

Hi Eve! I visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com). It's a simple blog sharing your love for hiking. Consider adding more posts, categories, and maybe an 'About Me' page to engage readers further. Keep up the great work!
